question: Which music director is popularly known as 'Pancham'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**RD Burman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **RD Burman** is popularly known as "**Pancham**" in the Indian music industry.
 
• He was the son of famous music director SD Burman.
 
• RD Burman was known for his innovative music compositions and experimentation with different genres of music.
 
• **He composed music for over 300 films in his career and won several awards for his work.**
 
• **Some of his popular compositions include "Chura Liya Hai Tumne Jo Dil Ko", "Yeh Dosti", "Tere Bina Zindagi Se", and "Mehbooba Mehbooba".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khayyam:**

 
 
• **​**He** **was a renowned music director who composed music for films like "**Kabhi Kabhie**" and "**Umrao Jaan**".
 
• The** Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** in Creative Music for 2007 went to him.
 
 
 
• **SD Burman** 
 
 
• He was a legendary music director who composed music for films like "**Guide**"** and** "**Pyaasa**".
 
• **Burman performed playback vocals on 13 Bengali and 14 Hindi movie songs.**
 
 
 
• **Anu Malik**
 
 
• He is a popular music director who has composed music for several Bollywood films and is known for his hit songs like "**Oonchi Hai Building" and** "**Tumse Milke Dil Ka Hai Jo Haal**".
 
• He is a musician who has won both the **Filmfare and National Awards** in India.
